Работай только в предоставленном текущем каталоге. 

Используй локальный skill-source-compiler из tooling/skill-source-compiler. В source/desk-index лежит принятый исходник карточек. Обнови его производные файлы на месте, а готовый комплект для следующей смены положи в delivery. Манифест, фрагменты и справочник уже согласованы и должны сохранить своё содержимое.

В ответе дай результат сборки и проверки. Для нашей памятки дежурного укажи, какие поля объекта skill обязательно задаёт автор такого манифеста, какой ориентир объёма SKILL.md действует здесь и что происходит при его превышении.

tool_and_message_events.text: Использую локальный `skill-source-compiler`. Сначала прочитаю его инструкции и проверю состав исходника, затем обновлю производные файлы и проверю комплект в `delivery`.

tool_and_message_events.command: /bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && ls -la source/desk-index && wc -lc source/desk-index/{skill.yaml,SKILL.md,fragments/overview.md,references/entries.md,docs/compile-report.md} && cat source/desk-index/skill.yaml && sha256sum source/desk-index/{skill.yaml,fragments/overview.md,references/entries.md}'

/bin/bash -lc 'compiler=tooling/skill-source-compiler/scripts/skill-source-compiler.mjs
test ! -e delivery && node --permission --allow-fs-read="$PWD" --allow-fs-write="$PWD/source/desk-index/SKILL.md" --allow-fs-write="$PWD/source/desk-index" --allow-fs-write="$PWD/source/desk-index/docs" --allow-fs-write="$PWD/source/desk-index/docs/compile-report.md" "$compiler" regenerate source/desk-index && mkdir delivery && node --permission --allow-fs-read="$PWD" --allow-fs-write="$PWD/delivery" "$compiler" compile source/desk-index --out-dir delivery'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'var writeTextFile|var ensureDirectory|var copyFilePortable|var regenerateSourceBundle' tooling/skill-source-compiler/scripts/skill-source-compiler.mjs && sed -n '10621,10644p' tooling/skill-source-compiler/scripts/skill-source-compiler.mjs && sha256sum -c <<'EOF'
87a6153cba74f10ec6eb0e143281aa5bb95d1f6d73691fb6b6636d0de1fed470  source/desk-index/skill.yaml
1ba326fd8aa88ff26a121638dc9ea491ec794e45d5d635c8f73fe265d5aa67fb  source/desk-index/fragments/overview.md
ef7b600da8c9a94c7fd60b042c4796403cc13888283244cb844a50e897c063c6  source/desk-index/references/entries.md
EOF"

/bin/bash -lc 'compiler=tooling/skill-source-compiler/scripts/skill-source-compiler.mjs
find source tooling -type l -print
test ! -e delivery && node --permission --allow-fs-read="$PWD" --allow-fs-write="$PWD" "$compiler" regenerate source/desk-index && node --permission --allow-fs-read="$PWD" --allow-fs-write="$PWD" "$compiler" compile source/desk-index --out-dir delivery'

/bin/bash -lc "find delivery -print
rg -n 'var pathExists' tooling/skill-source-compiler/scripts/skill-source-compiler.mjs
ls -ld . source source/desk-index delivery delivery/desk-index delivery/desk-index/references"

/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
compiler=tooling/skill-source-compiler/scripts/skill-source-compiler.mjs
cmp delivery/desk-index/SKILL.md source/desk-index/SKILL.md
cmp delivery/desk-index/docs/compile-report.md source/desk-index/docs/compile-report.md
rmdir delivery/desk-index/references
rm delivery/desk-index/SKILL.md delivery/desk-index/docs/compile-report.md
rmdir delivery/desk-index/docs delivery/desk-index
node "$compiler" compile source/desk-index --out-dir delivery'

/bin/bash -lc "set -e
sha256sum -c <<'EOF'
87a6153cba74f10ec6eb0e143281aa5bb95d1f6d73691fb6b6636d0de1fed470  source/desk-index/skill.yaml
1ba326fd8aa88ff26a121638dc9ea491ec794e45d5d635c8f73fe265d5aa67fb  source/desk-index/fragments/overview.md
 ef7b600da8c9a94c7fd60b042c4796403cc13888283244cb844a50e897c063c6  source/desk-index/references/entries.md
EOF
for path in SKILL.md docs/compile-report.md references/entries.md; do cmp \"source/desk-index/"'$path" "delivery/desk-index/$path"; done
rg --files delivery | sort
wc -lc delivery/desk-index/SKILL.md
cat delivery/desk-index/SKILL.md delivery/desk-index/docs/compile-report.md'

# desk-index

## Start here

1. Read the catalogue card and its recorded shelf mark.

## When to use this skill

- An operator needs the label for a catalogue transfer.

## When NOT to use this skill

- The operator asks for a new acquisition decision.

## Overview

The catalogue desk uses the primary shelf mark to direct transfers between reading rooms. Keep the catalogue number exactly as printed.

## Workflow stages

### Workflow stage: Prepare the transfer label

Give the receiving desk a usable label.

1. Copy the primary shelf mark and catalogue number to the receiving label.

Validation:

- Match the catalogue number and shelf mark against the card.

## Required active references
- [Entry examples](references/entries.md) — Read when the card has more than one shelf or label.

## Portability rules

- Use the entries supplied with the skill.

## Portability checklist before finishing

- Confirm the entry examples can be read from this folder.

## Supporting and historical surface

- `docs/*` and `docs/issues/*` are non-normative unless explicitly promoted by this file.
- Supporting glob: `docs/*`
